source.title: Towards robust and high-capacity coverless image steganography

method_specified.feature_space: Pseudo-Zernike moments on the Y channel after RGB-to-YUV conversion; low-order coefficients selected from Omega_N
method_specified.sa_pqe: Piecewise modulo-Delta quantization, one coefficient per bit, per-image stability score from minimum safe distance to a quantization decision boundary
method_specified.cid: K-means on binary vectors with K=2^L; one representative image per cluster
method_specified.extraction: PZM -> SA-PQE binary vector -> nearest CID centroid -> cluster index
method_specified.native_robustness: fraction of the 2^L CID representative images whose message segment is recovered correctly after an attack

native_message_carrier_count.formula: T+1 images where T=ceil(P/L) for a P-bit message; the final image conveys padding length
native_message_carrier_count.comparability_warning: These are source-native counts for the raw message bitstream and exclude ARCIS authenticated-envelope, replay-control, Reed-Solomon, and five-cover majority overhead.

reproducibility_limitations_for_exact_in: The article defines complex-valued PZM moments but does not explicitly state whether SA-PQE applies to magnitude, real part, or another scalar projection before modulo quantization.
The article gives W x W in the discrete PZM equation but does not state a common image resizing/resampling rule or fixed W for the heterogeneous datasets.
The K-means initialization, number of restarts, stopping tolerance, implementation/library, and random seeds are not reported.
Attack parameter labels are reported, but the exact image-processing implementation choices (interpolation, padding/fill, noise RNG, JPEG/JPEG2000 library settings) are not fully frozen.
The identities of the 50,000 selected ImageNet validation images are not frozen in the article.
The article states that data will be made available on request and does not provide a public code repository link.

decision.aligned_reimplementation: Allowed only if explicitly labelled Guo-Ping-derived and all previously unspecified implementation choices are frozen and disclosed.
